1. (Currently amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, __wherein said plurality of fins are longitudinally extending fins and said plurality of light emitting diodes are arranged to emit light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body__.

2. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open __to permit airflow through the hollow columnar body__.

3. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 further including a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes, __said optic element being disposed between adjacent fins__.

4. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material __for converting light emitted by said diodes__.

5. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body __with at least one diode on each face of the columnar body__.

6. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __such that each fin is located at a corner between adjacent faces carrying said diodes__.

7. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section, __the cross-section defining a plurality of substantially straight faces joined by corners__.

8. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body __and no diode resides on a corner of said columnar body__.

9. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body __and extends radially outwardly from the respective corner__.

10. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face __between adjacent fins__.

11. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, __said columnar body and said fins being integrally formed as a one-piece heat sink__.

12. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 9 including a single optic element __that__ is disposed between each adjacent fin over-lapping said diode.

13. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base, __the base member closing said first end of the columnar body__.

14. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current, __said printed circuit board being disposed within the hollow columnar body between said base member and an open second end of the columnar body__.

15. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body, __through a light-emitting region located between adjacent fins__.

16. (Currently amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline, __wherein said second end remains open to permit airflow through said hollow polygonal body__.

17. (Currently amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode, __wherein the extruding forms a polygonal body having substantially straight side walls and integral radially extending fins__.

18. (Previously presented) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/mK.

19. (Previously presented) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body has substantially straight side walls __defining faces of a polygonal cross-section__.
